text: Replay-deterministic runtimes turn agent execution into auditable software, where every model call, tool call, and decision can be re-executed bit-identically — something ad-hoc scripts can't promise.
They make agent runs testable: same inputs always produce the same trace, so regressions show up as diffs instead of folklore.
Determinism plus replay turns LLM workflows from one-off chats into durable, version-controlled artifacts that organizations can govern.
